headline: US Investors Boost Kenya Portfolio Holdings to Four-Year High
summary: Portfolio investments from US-based institutions in Kenya reached a four-year high, driven by high domestic yield spreads despite tight monetary conditions in developed markets.
why: Kenya's financial markets serve as a major hub for foreign portfolio flows into East Africa.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: Increased foreign capital allocations enhance domestic liquidity and support local asset valuations.
